description.en: Bông is a shy little cloud who thinks her rain is too small to matter, until a thirsty tea hill needs her.
description.vi: Bông là đám mây nhỏ nhút nhát, cứ nghĩ mưa của mình bé quá chẳng giúp được ai, cho đến ngày đồi chè khát nước.

theme.vi: Giúp đỡ nhẹ nhàng vẫn là giúp đỡ.

origin: Original StoryMoon story, written in Vietnamese with an English companion text.

characters.name: Bông
characters.look: small round cloud, soft white with a faint lavender blush, sleepy half-moon eyes and rosy cheeks

characters.name: the Breeze (Chị Gió)
characters.look: a ribbon of pale mint air with a few swirling tea leaves, kind smile, no body

characters.name: the tiny sprout
characters.look: a two-leaf green sprout with a round dewdrop head between rows of tea bushes

artDirection.mood: Airy, soft and hopeful; a quiet afternoon turning into a fresh, rain-washed evening.
artDirection.setting: Rolling terraced tea hills in Vietnam's highlands: neat rounded rows of tea bushes, wildflowers on the slopes, a winding red-earth path, distant blue mountains.
artDirection.light: Hazy summer daylight, then a soft silver drizzle, ending in a pastel sunset with a faint rainbow.
avoid: dark storm clouds that look threatening

cover.prompt: a small shy lavender-white cloud peeking over a green terraced tea hill, a fine silver drizzle falling, a pastel rainbow behind

pages.prompt: a small shy cloud half-hidden behind the top of a terraced tea hill, other clouds drifting high above
sentences: High above a green tea hill floated a little cloud named Bông.
Trên đồi chè xanh, có một đám mây nhỏ tên là Bông.
Bông was very shy, and often hid behind the hilltop.
Bông rất nhút nhát, hay nấp sau đỉnh đồi.

pages.prompt: big grey-blue clouds pouring heavy rain over far mountains, the little cloud watching from a distance with wide eyes
sentences: The big clouds rumbled and poured down heavy rain.
Các bác mây lớn thường ầm ầm đổ những cơn mưa thật to.
“I could never be that loud,” Bông thought quietly.
Bông khẽ nghĩ: “Mình chẳng bao giờ ầm ĩ được như thế.”

pages.prompt: a dry, sun-faded tea hill, drooping tea buds and bowed wildflowers, a tiny sprout looking up at the sky
sentences: One hot summer, the tea hill grew very dry.
Một mùa hè nắng gắt, đồi chè khô cong.
The little tea buds drooped, and the wildflowers bowed their heads.
Những búp chè non rũ xuống, hoa dại cúi đầu.
A tiny sprout looked up and whispered, “I'm so thirsty.”
Một mầm cây bé xíu ngước lên thì thầm: “Tớ khát quá.”

pages.prompt: the little cloud hovering above the hill, hesitating, looking down at the sprout with a worried face
sentences: Bông wanted to help, but she was afraid.
Bông muốn giúp lắm, nhưng lại sợ.
“What if my rain is too small?” she wondered.
“Nhỡ mưa của mình nhỏ quá thì sao?” Bông băn khoăn.

pages.prompt: a ribbon of pale mint breeze swirling tea leaves around the little cloud, speaking kindly to her
sentences: A gentle breeze came by and said, “Small rain is still rain.”
Chị Gió nhẹ nhàng bay qua, bảo rằng: “Mưa nhỏ thì vẫn là mưa mà em.”
“Just begin softly, one drop at a time.”
“Cứ bắt đầu thật khẽ, từng giọt một thôi.”

pages.prompt: the little cloud releasing a fine silver drizzle over the tea rows, first single drops then a soft misty curtain
sentences: So Bông took a breath and let go of one little drop. Pit!
Thế là Bông hít một hơi, thả xuống một giọt nước nhỏ. Tách!
Then another, and another, soft as a whisper.
Rồi giọt nữa, giọt nữa, nhẹ như một lời thì thầm.
A fine, gentle rain fell over the whole hill.
Một cơn mưa bụi dịu dàng rắc khắp ngọn đồi.

pages.prompt: fresh rain-washed tea bushes with lifted glossy leaves, wildflowers open again, the sprout stretching up happily
sentences: The tea buds lifted their leaves, and the flowers opened again.
Búp chè vươn lá, hoa dại lại nở tươi.
The tiny sprout stretched up and said, “Thank you, Bông!”
Mầm cây nhỏ vươn vai: “Cảm ơn Bông nhé!”

pages.prompt: a pastel sunset over the tea hills with a faint rainbow, the little cloud floating openly in the sky, smiling
sentences: As the sun went down, a soft rainbow appeared over the hill.
Khi mặt trời lặn, một cầu vồng mờ hiện lên trên đồi.
That evening, Bông did not hide. She floated gently, feeling light and happy.
Tối hôm ấy, Bông không nấp nữa. Bông lững lờ trôi, lòng nhẹ tênh và vui vui.
